annotations.title: Do AI assistants describe us correctly?

description: Use when the user asks what ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Perplexity say about their company, or whether assistants get their facts right: "does ChatGPT know where we are based?", "do AI assistants know our pricing?". Asks four assistants about the brand twice each and returns how many answers recognize it, how many state each fact you give, and a short excerpt where each appears. An answer that leaves a fact out is not marked wrong. Refuses before you are charged if too few answers come back or your values are too generic to test. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: one moment; re-run to build a series; segment: facts (each fact checked). Price: $0.83 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $1.15 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For whether the brand’s site is cited, rather than described, use run_ai_visibility.
